mapping.scientific_finding: A derived local molecular model establishes acetophenone and ethyl-radical formation.
The acetophenone-forming local barrier is recovered on its correctly connected reactant reference.
The distinct propiophenone/methyl-radical cleavage is computationally identified and quantified.
Comparable connected local barriers favor the acetophenone/ethyl branch.
Chlorine-mediated benzylic hydrogen abstraction is a locally accessible substrate transformation.

allocation_rationale: Transfer 10 points from product identification and 10 from the ethyl barrier to the new, distinct chlorine-HAT finding. Retain competing channel/order allocations. Total 100; no score for inactive singlet-HAT, reporting validity or repeated synthesis.
